e.title: IUMI（国际水险联盟）：全球水险统计、统计档案与会员统计
e.title_en: IUMI (International Union of Marine Insurance): global marine statistics, a statistics archive and member statistics
e.title_hk: IUMI（國際水險聯盟）：全球水險統計、統計檔案與會員統計
e.summary: 国际水险联盟：设有全球水险统计、统计档案（历史各年）与会员统计三个独立入口，发布年度统计报告与船体/货运/内河/渔船/游艇等分线市场评论，并有区域水险市场播客
e.summary_en: The International Union of Marine Insurance: it runs three separate entry points — global marine statistics, a historical statistics archive and member statistics — publishes an annual stats report and line-by-line market commentaries (hull, cargo, inland hull, fishing vessels, yachts), and offers regional marine market podcasts
e.summary_hk: 國際水險聯盟：設有全球水險統計、統計檔案（歷史各年）與會員統計三個獨立入口，發布年度統計報告與船體／貨運／內河／漁船／遊艇等分線市場評論，並有區域水險市場播客
e.body:
**IUMI（International Union of Marine Insurance，国际水险联盟）** 是**全球水险业的国际组织**（站点标题实测即「International Union of Marine Insurance」）。本条目与同轮 [[cefor]] 构成**「全球层 vs 北欧层」的水险数据对照**：**Cefor 是区域协会的共享理赔池，IUMI 是覆盖更广的全球统计与分线市场评论**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200（体量约 1,086KB，为**内容型大站**），标题实测 **「International Union of Marine Insurance」**；⭐ **「Statistics」页 `/statistics/` 实测 485.3KB，标题「International Union of Marine Insurance | Statistics」**；⭐ **「Statistics Archive（统计档案）」页 `/statistics-archive/` 实测 295.3KB，标题「…| Statistics Archive」**——**历史各年统计的归档入口**；⭐ **「Member statistics（会员统计）」页 `/member-statistics/` 实测 610.9KB，标题「…| Member statistics」**——**四页中体量最大**；实测另见新闻/通讯入口 **「annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi」（年度统计报告已发布）** 与 **「the-iumi-stats-report-2025」（IUMI 2025 统计报告）**；**分线市场评论的新闻标题实测可见**：**「A stable cargo marine insurance market but uncertainty looms, warns IUMI」**、**「Inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht insurers report general market soundness, however challenges remain ahead」**、**「Steady insurance markets for hull and cargo in 2024, but offshore energy business is challenged, headwinds loom for all markets」**、**「IUMI highlights challenging hull marine insurance market and elevated risk」**；**另有中东局势相关声明**（**2026 年 6 月的两则**）与 **`/annual-conference-archive/`（年会档案）**；**播客栏目**实测含**拉丁美洲、中国、印度水险市场**与**非法/无管制/未报告捕鱼**等主题。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「全球水险的分线市场评论」这一层**——**Cefor 给的是共享理赔数据（量化），IUMI 给的是分线市场判断（船体、货运、内河船体、渔船、游艇、离岸能源）**；**两者并读正好是「数据 + 判断」，也是行业组织向会员输出的两种典型产品**。**② 「统计档案」对做时间序列的学生直接有用**——**历史各年统计集中在 `/statistics-archive/`**，**不必逐年找报告**；这种**档案化设计**与池内 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的「长期序列」思路一致，只是险种不同。**③ 「会员统计」页体量最大（610.9KB）**，说明**其统计颗粒度可能到会员/公司层**——**但本次未打开内容，故本词条不主张其颗粒度**（**这一点已在下面如实标注**）。**④ 中东局势声明（2026 年 6 月）说明水险是地缘政治敏感险种**——**战争险、航运中断与保险可得性**是水险特有议题，**这与池内政治风险类条目的空白形成呼应**（**本轮实测「政治风险」形态为 0，已在轮次日志中记录为后续候选**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与新闻标题**，**但未打开任何统计表格、未下载任何统计报告、未打开任何分线市场评论正文、未打开任何播客音频**，因此**不能转述任何保费规模、损失率、市场费率水平或会员统计数值**；**② 「统计报告」「分线评论」的结论本次全部未读取**——**页面上可见的只是新闻标题**，**本词条不据标题转述其内容**；**③ 「会员统计」的颗粒度（是否到公司层）本次未核实**，**故不作主张**；**④ IUMI 的会员构成（各国协会 vs 直接公司会员）、与 Cefor 及各区域协会的关系本次未核实**；**⑤ 统计是否对非会员开放、是否需要登录本次未核实**；**⑥ 首页体量约 1,086KB 为实测值**，**其中内容与脚本资源各占多少本次未区分**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IUMI 提供精算软件、建模工具或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（约 1,086KB）、`/statistics/`（485.3KB）、`/statistics-archive/`（295.3KB）、`/member-statistics/`（610.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与新闻标题；**未打开统计表格、统计报告、市场评论正文或播客**。
e.body_en:
**IUMI (the International Union of Marine Insurance)** is **the international organisation of the marine insurance industry** (its measured site title is simply "International Union of Marine Insurance"). With [[cefor]] from the same round it forms a **"global versus Nordic" marine data contrast**: **Cefor is a regional association’s shared claims pool; IUMI is broader global statistics plus line-by-line market commentary**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 (about **1,086KB**, a **content-heavy site**) with the measured title **"International Union of Marine Insurance"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics" page `/statistics/` measures 485.3KB with the title "International Union of Marine Insurance | Statistics"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics Archive" page `/statistics-archive/` measures 295.3KB** — **the archival entry point to historical years**; ⭐ the **"Member statistics" page `/member-statistics/` measures 610.9KB** — **the largest of the four**; measured news and newsletter entry points include **"annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi"** and **"the-iumi-stats-report-2025"**; **measured market-commentary headlines** include **"A stable cargo marine insurance market but uncertainty looms, warns IUMI"**, **"Inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht insurers report general market soundness, however challenges remain ahead"**, **"Steady insurance markets for hull and cargo in 2024, but offshore energy business is challenged, headwinds loom for all markets"** and **"IUMI highlights challenging hull marine insurance market and elevated risk"**; there are also **two measured statements on the Middle East situation (both June 2026)** and **`/annual-conference-archive/`**; the **podcast section** measurably covers **the Latin American, Chinese and Indian marine markets** and **illegal, unregulated and unreported fishing**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "global line-by-line marine market commentary" layer** — **Cefor supplies shared claims data (quantitative); IUMI supplies line-level market judgement (hull, cargo, inland hull, fishing vessels, yachts, offshore energy)**; **read together they are "data plus judgement", the two typical products a trade body gives its members**. **② The statistics archive directly serves time-series work** — **historical years are gathered at `/statistics-archive/`**, **so reports need not be hunted year by year**; this **archival design** matches the "long series" thinking of [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[human-mortality-db]], only in a different line. **③ The member statistics page is the largest (610.9KB)**, suggesting **granularity possibly down to member or company level** — **but its content was not opened, so this entry does not assert that granularity** (**flagged below**). **④ The June 2026 Middle East statements show marine is a geopolitically sensitive line** — **war risk, shipping disruption and insurance availability** are marine-specific issues, **echoing the corpus’s gap on political risk** (**this round measured "political risk" at zero and logged it as a later candidate**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and news headlines**, **but opened no statistics table, downloaded no statistics report, opened no market commentary body and opened no podcast audio**, so **no premium volume, loss ratio, market rate level or member statistic can be restated**; **② the reports’ and commentaries’ conclusions were entirely unread** — **only headlines were visible, and this entry does not restate their content from headlines**; **③ the granularity of "member statistics" (whether it reaches company level) was not verified**, **so no claim is made**; **④ IUMI’s membership composition (national associations versus direct corporate members) and its relationship to Cefor and regional associations were not verified**; **⑤ whether the statistics are open to non-members or require login was not verified**; **⑥ the homepage size of about 1,086KB is a measured value**, **and content versus script assets were not distinguished**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim IUMI provides actuarial software, modelling tools or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (about 1,086KB), `/statistics/` (485.3KB), `/statistics-archive/` (295.3KB) and `/member-statistics/` (610.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and headlines read; **no statistics table, report, commentary body or podcast was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**IUMI（International Union of Marine Insurance，國際水險聯盟）** 是**全球水險業的國際組織**（標題實測「International Union of Marine Insurance」）。本條目與同輪 [[cefor]] 構成**「全球層 vs 北歐層」的水險數據對照**：**Cefor 是區域協會的共享理賠池，IUMI 是覆蓋更廣的全球統計與分線市場評論**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁約 **1,086KB**（內容型大站）；⭐ **「Statistics」頁 485.3KB**；⭐ **「Statistics Archive」頁 295.3KB**——**歷史各年統計歸檔入口**；⭐ **「Member statistics」頁 610.9KB**——**四頁中體量最大**；實測另見 **「annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi」** 與 **「the-iumi-stats-report-2025」**；**分線市場評論新聞標題實測**含 **「A stable cargo marine insurance market but uncertainty looms, warns IUMI」**、**「Inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht insurers report general market soundness…」**、**「Steady insurance markets for hull and cargo in 2024, but offshore energy business is challenged…」**；**另有 2026 年 6 月兩則中東局勢聲明**與 **`/annual-conference-archive/`**；**播客**含**拉丁美洲、中國、印度水險市場**與**非法捕魚**等主題。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「全球水險分線市場評論」這一層**——**Cefor 給共享理賠數據（量化），IUMI 給分線市場判斷（船體、貨運、內河、漁船、遊艇、離岸能源）**；**兩者並讀正好是「數據 + 判斷」**。**② 「統計檔案」對做時間序列的學生直接有用**——**歷史各年集中在 `/statistics-archive/`**；這種**歸檔化設計**與 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的「長期序列」思路一致。**③ 「會員統計」頁體量最大（610.9KB）**，**但本次未打開內容，故不主張其顆粒度**。**④ 中東局勢聲明說明水險是地緣政治敏感險種**——**戰爭險、航運中斷與保險可得性**是水險特有議題，**與池內政治風險類條目的空白形成呼應**（**本輪實測「政治風險」形態為 0，已記為後續候選**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與新聞標題**，**但未打開任何統計表格、未下載任何統計報告、未打開任何市場評論正文、未打開任何播客音頻**，故**不能轉述任何保費規模、損失率、市場費率水平或會員統計數值**；**② 報告與評論的結論全部未讀取**——**可見的只是新聞標題，本詞條不據標題轉述其內容**；**③ 「會員統計」顆粒度未核實，故不作主張**；**④ 會員構成、與 Cefor 及區域協會的關係未核實**；**⑤ 統計是否對非會員開放、是否需登入未核實**；**⑥ 首頁體量約 1,086KB 為實測值**，內容與腳本資源未區分；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** IUMI 提供精算軟件、建模工具或逐單數據**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與新聞標題；**未打開統計表格、報告、評論正文或播客**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页约 1,086KB 标题「International Union of Marine Insurance」；⭐/statistics/ 485.3KB 标题「International Union of Marine Insurance | Statistics」；⭐/statistics-archive/ 295.3KB 标题含「Statistics Archive」；⭐/member-statistics/ 610.9KB 标题含「Member statistics」；实测新闻/通讯入口含 annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi、the-iumi-stats-report-2025；分线市场评论标题实测含 cargo / inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht / hull and cargo 2024 + offshore energy / hull market elevated risk；含 2026 年 6 月两则中东局势声明；播客含拉美、中国、印度水险市场与非法捕鱼）+ ★与同轮 cefor 构成全球层 vs 北欧层对照；未打开统计表格、未下载统计报告、未打开市场评论正文或播客；未核实会员统计颗粒度、会员构成、是否需登录
